body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a display policy builder, validator, and associated tests for post-attempt mark scheme (MS) display policies, ensuring that student-facing display postures are securely resolved and validated. The feedback recommends enhancing input validation by explicitly checking that expected array fields from upstream schemas are arrays to prevent TypeErrors, and strictly ordering check IDs and arrays alphabetically to ensure deterministic validation output.
